learner_prose_repairs.before: Learn the alternating stems together: nearu in the selected nominative singular forms; nearw- before vowel endings; nearo- before consonantal -ne, -re and -ra. Thus the case ending can select a different visible stem. The weak forms use nearw-.

The weak forms use nearw- except for genitive plural nearora.
